transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess I just... I keep feeling like I ruined things for everybody. Like I'm just a fake in my apprenticeship, I guess. I feel like I let my family down... and the younger apprentices... just over stuff that I know other people would probably just fix and move on from.
How long have you been feeling this way—has it been going on for a couple of weeks, or more like months or years?

It's been... I don't know, maybe around nine months? It just sort of... dragged on. I guess I didn't really think about it much until my classes and the apprenticeship stuff started getting harder to keep up with. It's just been a while.
Over these past nine months, would you say you've felt down or low nearly every day, most of the day, or has it come and gone in waves with some better stretches in between?
I guess... mostly every day. I don't really remember having many good days lately. It's just... kind of always there.
Before these past nine months, had you ever gone through a similar stretch of feeling this down in the past—say, months or years ago—followed by periods where you felt essentially normal again?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I've ever felt quite like this before... just this time, I guess.
Over these past nine months, have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I guess so. I used to... I don't know, draw a lot. Had a sketchbook. I used to play volleyball too, and do some volunteer stuff. But lately... I just walk past the sketchbook. I skip the games. I see the group texts from the volunteer thing and just... ignore them. I don't really feel much about it anymore. They used to be my thing, but now... yeah, I just don't care as much.
Over these past nine months, have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself or wishing you weren't alive?

Um... I don't know. I mean, I don't have a plan to actually do anything to myself. But... sometimes, like if I'm driving or just lying in bed... I just kind of think it would be easier if I didn't wake up.

Would you say these feelings have made it hard for you to keep up with your daily responsibilities—like your apprenticeship, classes, or basic self-care—or are you still managing to get through your day despite the struggle?

Um... yeah. It's... it's been hard. My foreman and my instructors, they've... they've had to chase me down a bit lately. Just for, like, unfinished sketches and... I guess I've been a lot slower on the job. I don't really know. I'm just... I'm scared I'm close to messing up my apprenticeship, and my certification. I worked really hard to get it, so... yeah. It's definitely affecting things.
Have you noticed changes in your sleep or appetite over these past nine months—such as sleeping much more or less than usual, or a significant change in your eating?

Um... sleep's been kind of all over the place, I guess. Like, for a while... I was only getting maybe three or four hours a night. But I'd still show up wired for the job and my classes. Lately though... I don't know. I just can't fall asleep. Or if I do, I wake up way before my alarm and... just feel like I never rested at all. So, yeah.

Would you say you're still managing to get through most of your work and daily tasks, even if it's a real struggle, or has it gotten to the point where you're barely able to function at all most days?
Um... I'm still managing, mostly. I mean, I still show up to the job site and my classes. It just... takes more effort, I guess. But I'm getting it done.
Have you experienced anything like hearing voices, seeing things that others don't, or having thoughts or beliefs that others might find unusual or hard to believe?
Um... no. I haven't... I don't hear voices or anything like that. No.
How often are you having those thoughts that it would be easier not to wake up—are they happening daily, several times a week, or just occasionally?

Um... I guess they happen a few times a week. Like... when I'm driving home after class, or just lying there awake. I don't have a plan to hurt myself or anything. It's just... sometimes I think it would be easier if I didn't wake up tomorrow. But it's not every day.
Over these past nine months, have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy, even after resting?
Um... yeah. I guess I've been pretty tired. Even if I sleep, it doesn't really seem to help much.
Have you noticed trouble concentrating or making even simple decisions lately—like difficulty focusing on your coursework or figuring out basic daily choices?
Um... no, not really. I mean... I guess I can focus fine. I haven't really noticed any problems making decisions or anything.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight over these past nine months—either eating much more or much less than usual?
Um... no, not really. I think my eating is about the same. I haven't noticed any weight changes.
